⁨We’ve all seen the chaos unleashed by Democrats at airports across the country. It’s preposterous that Chuck Schumer continues to hold TSA funding hostage.

Thankfully, ICE will bring sanity to our airports starting tomorrow, but it’s far past time for Democrats to fund DHS.

Americans deserve to have their voices heard, and that starts with safe and secure elections. Pass the Save America Act NOW.

The Vance family is praying for our dear friend as she takes on her next fight!

Please join me in praying for the six service members who lost their lives in a plane crash over the skies of Iraq. Three were Ohioans serving with the 121st Air Refueling Wing, a unit I was honored to visit as a senator. A grateful nation mourns their loss.

The appropriate number of illegal immigrants voting in our elections is ZERO.

The SAVE America Act is common sense, and we need to pass it now!


Rapid Response 47 (@RapidResponse47)

.@POTUS on the SAVE America Act: "We want Voter I.D., we want proof of citizenship... no men playing in women's sports... no transgender mutilation of our children — very basic things that you wouldn't even think we'd be talking about 15 or 20 years ago."
